text: The School of Information Science is constituted of Information Management Department, Computer Science and Technology Department, E-Commerce Department, Public Teaching Department, Specialized Labs, Career Design Studio and other auxiliary teaching organizations. There are 22 professors and associate professors, 33 PhDs (including PhD candidates), and 866 undergraduates. In recent years, the school has engaged in around 10 ministerial and provincial research projects, and taken part in 'Golden Audit project' and '863 Project' and other national projects. Over 600 theses have been published in journals like Soft Science Journal, Computer Science. Around 10 treatises including Audit of the computer information management have been issued by the department. The school has also won several awards in teaching and research. B.A. Information System Management Objectives: This program fosters students who have the knowledge of the foundation of modern management theory, computer science and technology. The students would also have a systematic ideology, and the ability of systematic information analysis, design and information management. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Management Degree Main Courses: Economics, Accountancy, Marketing Science, Management of Production and Operation, Organizational Strategies and Behaviors, Principles of Management, Application Mathematical Statistics, Operational Research, Information Management Basics, Database Principle and Applications, Computer Network, Information Management Science, Information Organization Science, Information System Analysis and Design.
